summary: Software Engineering graduate from ITCR with hands-on experience building full-stack applications and end-to-end data pipelines using SQL, Python, AWS, and Power BI—from schema design and ETL to interactive dashboards and cloud infrastructure. experience.title: Software Engineer Intern — SIGAC: Integrated Scheduling & Consulting Room Management System
bullets: Designed relational database schemas and stored procedures in MySQL to enforce complex scheduling constraints across a public hospital's multi-department operations, ensuring data integrity under concurrent multi-user access.
Proactively built a statistics and reporting feature beyond the original project scope, giving stakeholders visibility into scheduling trends and resource utilization.

Gathered requirements directly from healthcare stakeholders, translating clinical workflows into technical solutions with role-based access control; built responsive interfaces with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
Technologies: MySQL, SQL, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Figma
